name: sharon-and-nadav-wedding
description: Face-based wedding photo gallery for Nadav & Sharon. The site itself is static (no build step); Node is used only for offline face indexing.
//deps: tfjs-node (native, ~3x faster per-thread) is intentionally NOT a dependency: it publishes no NAPI-v10 prebuilt binding, so it cannot load on Node >=22 (see README). The indexer still probes for it at runtime and will use it automatically if you install it on an older Node. Parallelism comes from a worker_threads pool instead.
